caption:
Stop clicking through 20 tabs. ⌨️

Ctrl + 1 to 8: jump to that tab
Ctrl + 9: jump to the last tab
Ctrl + Tab: next tab
Ctrl + Shift + Tab: previous tab

On Mac use Cmd for number jumps. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#shortcuts #keyboardshortcuts #chrome #browser #productivity #computertips #lifehack #timesaver #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: 20 tabs open and no idea where anything is?
scenes.say: Twenty tabs open and no idea where anything is? Jump with your keyboard.

scenes.title: Go to a specific tab
scenes.say: Hold control and press a number from one to eight. You jump straight to that tab.

scenes.title: Jump to the last tab
scenes.say: Control and nine takes you to the last tab, however many you have.
Control and tab moves to the next tab. Add shift to go back to the previous one.

scenes.label: use Cmd instead of Ctrl for number jumps
scenes.say: On a Mac, use the command key for the number jumps.
